name: observe-lens
description: Read-only investigation skills across CI pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions), CD (Argo CD, Flux, Helm, Kubernetes), databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB) and telemetry (Grafana, Loki, Tempo, Prometheus).

interface.shortDescription: Explain what happened across CI, CD, databases and telemetry
interface.longDescription: Read-only investigation of Jenkins and GitHub Actions runs, Argo CD, Flux, Helm and Kubernetes deployments, PostgreSQL, MySQL and MongoDB data, and Grafana, Loki, Tempo and Prometheus telemetry, with a router skill that correlates findings across them.
defaultPrompt: Why did the last CI run fail, and did it deploy?
